case_title: Water Purifier Failure and Health-Related Advertising Claim

expected_checklist.reason: The claimant's complaint notice is available.

additional_evidence_concerns.reason: No laboratory or independent test report establishes the actual quality of filtered water.

expected_defects.description: The claimant's allegation about water quality has not been supported by an independent test.
The claimant interprets the advertisement as guaranteeing completely safe drinking water, but the exact advertisement wording must be examined.

expected_review.reason: The standard checklist is complete, but independent water quality evidence and clearer maintenance records are needed.

expected_outcome.recommended_action: Obtain an independent water quality test and review the advertisement and maintenance records.

testing_notes: Separate advertising claims from verified product performance.
Do not infer a health risk or product liability finding without adequate evidence.
